description_expanded: Overview5.0(7 reviews)Gulf FrontCorner GULF FRONT unit and Renovated - Endless Gulf Views - `Sea You Again`The Space Sea You Again – Gulf-Front Luxury with Stunning Views! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Direct Gulf-Front Condo – Wake up to breathtaking emerald water views Private Beach Access – Steps from your door to the sugar-white sand Community Pool – Refreshing swim with unbeatable Gulf views (no pool heat available) Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected while unwinding in paradise 1,680 Sq Ft | 2 Bedrooms + Loft | 3 Bathrooms – Spacious retreat with plenty of room for family & friends Loft Sleeping Area – Extra space for three guests Western-End Unit – Enjoy unobstructed sunset views from two private balconies Wine Refrigerator & Wet Bar – Elevate your beachside happy hour Cozy Fireplace & Vaulted Ceilings – Elegant touches for a warm and inviting space 1 Designated Parking Spot + Limited Overflow – Convenient parking for your stay One Set of Beach Chairs Included (March - October) Professionally Managed – 24/7 Guest ServiceWelcome to Sea You AgainThose in the market for a bijou gulf-front condo will appreciate the many benefits of 'Sea You Again'. Vaulted ceilings and a handy sleeping loft for three extra guests maximize the space in this two-bedroom, three-bath 1,680 square foot hideaway. Blue Tide is a small complex of 18 units perched on one of the highest dunes south of Scenic 30A. This highly sought-after western end unit enjoys unobstructed sunset vistas from private balconies on both levels. Serve up perfect chilled glasses of wine from the wine refrigerator in the wet bar and toast another beautiful day in paradise. The living room is decorated in cool blues and pastel tints, providing a nod to the gulf views framed by floor-to-ceiling sliding doors. A feature fireplace and wood flooring add warmth to the spacious living/dining area. The open-plan kitchen has white cabinets, stainless appliances and a central island breakfast bar for casual dining or chatting with the cook. Doors open from the living room onto the balcony which has its own private entrance to the beach walkover. From there, the white sands, glittering emerald gulf and pristine dunes provide endless delights for nature lovers and beachcombers. Nicely positioned between Camp Creek Lake and Alys Beach, the condo is well located for beach walks, fishing, swimming and biking in the surrounding area. Shopping, breakfast cafés, restaurants and local amenities are within bicycling distance along the Timpoochee Biking Trail paralleling Scenic Highway 30A.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (8):Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private BathroomGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Twin Sleeper SofaLoft: 3 Twin BedsAREA ATTRACTONS:This easygoing beach neighborhood is the perfect place to escape for a beach vacation. Spend a day wandering through the shops and sights of Seacrest — you’ll spot everything from gorgeous dune lakes to gourmet restaurants. Then, unwind with a stroll along Seacrest’s sugar-white sand.A lively community gathers in Seacrest’s Peddler’s Pavilion. Sip coffee on an outdoor patio, stock up on homemade sweet treats, or rent a bicycle and go exploring. With wide-open green spaces and plenty of ecosploring opportunities, this beach neighborhood is a perfect fit for active vacationers.Show less
